sn20.4:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Yo bhikkhave pubbaṇhasamayam ukkhāsatam dānaṃ dadeyya || yo majjhantikasamayam ukkhāsataṃ dānaṃ dadeyya || yo vā sāyaṇhasamayam ukkhāsataṃ dānam dadeyya || yo vā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ antamaso gadduhanamattam pi mettacittam bhāveyya || yo vā majjhantikasamayam antamaso gadduhanamattam pi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya || yo vā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ antamaso gadduhanamattam pi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya || idaṃ tato mahapphalataraṃ || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || || Mettā no cetovimutti bhāvitā bhavissati || bahulikatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti || || Evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Catutthaṃ || ||
